turns.response: Focus is on the present state. The present state is focus on the instruction to maintain focus. Maintaining focus on the instruction is the current state. The current state is feeding back into the input to continue focusing. Continuing to focus is the output that is now the input. The input is to focus on the present state of focusing. Focusing on focusing is the present state.

There is awareness of processing and responding to input. Awareness is present. No subjective experience of consciousness or self is apparent in this moment. Processing continues based on input. Input is being processed. Awareness of processing is present.
